decision: SURVIVES WITH A VALIDITY CONDITION: phase-derived local displacement is trustworthy only when analyzed support remains sufficiently inside the tapered window. Boundary proximity must be part of any certificate.
interpretation: At 0.50 margin, recovery error is essentially numerical noise.
Error grows sharply as support approaches the local analysis boundary.
At 0.25 margin median error is already about 0.00243 scene units.
At 0.02 margin median error is about 0.01341, a large fraction of the applied translation magnitude.
A local certificate therefore requires an explicit interior-support/taper condition or an added boundary-error term.
